'''Jacus Redick''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as member of the [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] alongside fellow Green [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Redris Korin]] during the [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Behind the scenes==
Jacus Redick appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Corellia. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
